children: Trade.xyz said in a post on X that Nvidia plans to report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 results after market close on Tuesday, November 17. According to Odaily, maximum leverage on XYZ: Nvidia will temporarily drop from 20x to 10x at 8:05 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time on Sunday, November 15, and return to 20x after the earnings release.

title: XYZ: Nvidia’s Maximum Leverage Temporarily Cut to 10x, Returning to 20x After Earnings
